summary: migration_bridge.py materializes one declared future RED test without starting Quick Dev; supports slices W0-W6 with fixed test templates covering selection/content hash identity, stale continuation rejection, coverage gaps, degraded execution gates, current-pointer stability, retention approval, and end-to-end invalid-intermediate rejection; reads implementation-contract.v1.json and requires a matching slice, declared RED selector, planned new file, and test write-set permission; accepts exactly the current selector as snapshot path; plan must be under repository execution-plans; target must remain inside repository and exclude traversal, logs, and execution-plans paths; conflicting existing content fails, identical content is reused; new files are created with UTF-8 LF content; CLI requires --materialize-only and emits materialized status with slice/path and empty authorization list; unknown or undeclared slices, invalid selectors, boundary violations, and non-materialize invocation fail
